column3: Value
vs_nuget
Launch Visual Studio, create a C# Console App, open NuGet Package Manager, search and install Newtonsoft.Json, then build to verify the package is resolved.
screenshots/{timestamp}
Trigger
Open Start menu via Win key.
Type 'Visual Studio' into Start menu search.
Press Enter to launch Visual Studio.
Locate the VS main window; stash hwnd in vars.vs_hwnd.
Maximize the Visual Studio main window.
Find 'Create a new project' button on the Start Window.
Click 'Create a new project'.
Find the search box in the new project dialog.
Click the search box.
Type 'console app' in the search box.
Press Enter to submit the search.
Find the Console App C# template in results.
Click the Console App template.
Find the Next button (template page).
Click Next to go to project configuration.
Find the Next button (configuration page).
Click Next to go to Additional Information.
Find the Create button.
Click Create to generate the project.
column14: Project is created and loads in the editor.

column3: Re-locate the VS window after project creation.
Maximize the VS window after creation.
Screenshot after project creation.
Find the View menu.
Click the View menu.
Find Solution Explorer menu item.
Click Solution Explorer to ensure it is open.
Find the solution node in Solution Explorer.
Double-click the solution node to expand it.
Find the project node (2nd ConsoleApp TreeItem).
Right-click the project node to open context menu.
Find the Manage NuGet Packages menu item.
Click Manage NuGet Packages.
Screenshot after opening NuGet Package Manager.
Find the Browse tab in NuGet Package Manager.
Click the Browse tab.
Find the search box in NuGet Package Manager.
Click the NuGet search box.
Clear any existing text and type package name.
Type Newtonsoft.Json in the search box.
Find the Newtonsoft.Json package in results.
Click the Newtonsoft.Json package.
Find the Install button.
Click Install.
Accept license dialog if present (press Enter).
Screenshot after package install.
Find the Build menu.
Click the Build menu.
Find Build Solution menu item.
Click Build Solution.
Validate build succeeded in the Output window.
Screenshot after build.
Close the Visual Studio window.
